requirement: Revised privileged-access procedure approved and effective before closure
minimum_evidence: Approved procedure version matching the implemented workflow

requirement: Workflow prevents fulfillment until manager and application-owner approvals are recorded
minimum_evidence: Production change record plus configuration evidence

requirement: All 25 requests in the defined review population have both approvals and were tested after deployment
minimum_evidence: Post-deployment test covering 25 of 25 requests with traceable results

requirement: Orphan privileged account PA-009 is disabled and removed from active group membership
minimum_evidence: Account-removal record and current membership evidence

requirement: At least 30 consecutive days of monitoring show no approval-bypass exception
minimum_evidence: Monitoring report covering 30 complete days after deployment

requirement: Closure rationale reconciles all requirements and is reviewed by the issue owner
minimum_evidence: Closure rationale plus issue-owner review record
